name: Fairmont Makati
short_description: A One Michelin Key, 5-star Fairmont in the heart of Makati's CBD, sharing a tower with Raffles Makati, near Ayala Museum and Greenbelt, holding a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (4,042 reviews).
ai_summary: Fairmont Makati is a One Michelin Key, 5-star luxury hotel in Makati's central business and lifestyle district, sharing a tower with Raffles Makati and Raffles Residences Makati. It provides convenient access to the Ayala Museum and Greenbelt Shopping Centre for dining, luxury boutiques, and entertainment. The hotel has the largest review volume of any Accor property researched in this batch, holding a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 4,042 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
